title: Complexity walk state
statement: For natural numbers $C,e$, a Boolean $\mathit{suffix}$, and a natural number $i$, define a state as follows: if $i=0$, it is the walk state with flags $\mathit{suffix}$ and false; otherwise, if $\mathit{suffix}$ is true and $i=1$, it is the walk state with both flags true; in every other case, it is the seek state with flag $\mathit{suffix}$.
